title: Space contact enrichment never reads another owner’s private captures by matching email

source.ref: owner repository audit 2026-10-08: contact privacy boundary

detail: The actual Space contact request preserves its editor gate and contact-belongs-to-Space check, then enriches only from the authenticated viewer’s own capture or a card explicitly shared with this exact Space after current isSpaceTeamMember authorization (ADR-778). Email identity matching grants no source permission. Filtering precedes the 20-row cap; newest authorized non-null fields remain available. Other-owner private captures, other-Space shares, generic network visibility and platform-staff edit capability do not grant enrichment. Only phone/company/city are projected; private capture notes/tags/media and Vera memory are excluded. The runner-free behavioral probe executes the actual request module with two owners/two Spaces and a literal same email, including 25 newer forbidden captures, deliberate authorized sharing, wrong-Space/anonymous/non-editor callers and authorization/read failures. No production records or schema changes.

verify.note: Executes the actual contact-detail request against synthetic permission-sensitive captures; no database connection or test runner.
